subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop extensible for custom skill creation workflows

question: Should OpenClaw support a first-class skill-creation authority or routing API that can run custom workflows before `skill_workshop`, and if so should it live as a generic plugin hook, tool policy/config surface, or documented ClawHub workflow convention?
rationale: Current main has enough primitives to create proposal content and intercept selected tool calls, but not enough policy to guarantee a custom workflow is selected before the built-in tool; choosing that contract changes product/API direction.

options.title: Design a narrow plugin authority contract
options.body: Add or specify a generic plugin-owned pre-selection/routing contract for skill-creation workflows while keeping Skill Workshop as the only persistence/apply boundary.

options.title: Keep current convention
options.body: Document that custom workflows may prepare proposal content but cannot become the enforced authority over built-in `skill_workshop` selection.

options.title: Use tool policy only
options.body: Rely on `tools.allow`/`tools.deny` and `before_tool_call` to block or steer direct `skill_workshop` calls, accepting that this is not a dedicated skill-creation workflow API.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow plugin authority contract
recommendation.body: Add or specify a generic plugin-owned pre-selection/routing contract for skill-creation workflows while keeping Skill Workshop as the only persistence/apply boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the core Skill Workshop service path and are the strongest feature-history routing candidate in local evidence.
